info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Debug Flex Templates API
Google Cloud Dataflow Launch a Flex Template job in a specific location

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint where the job resides, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

items.docs: Launches a Dataflow job from a Flex Template in the specified project and regional location. Flex Templates package the pipeline code in a Docker container and support dynamic pipeline configuration at launch time.
